fixed_point_base_power_rounding.root_cause: Pinch abilities carried 1.5x and Thick Fat carried 0.5x as fractional f32 base power instead of Gen 3 Showdown fixed-point floor values.

dynamic_flail_reversal.showdown_transcript: Mightyena Crunch deals 108 to Dodrio, leaving 39/222, then Dodrio Flail deals 110.
dynamic_flail_reversal.root_cause: The engine retained only an average first-move damage roll, erasing reachable HP-band crossings before the second Flail/Reversal choice recomputed its base power.

forecast_cloud_nine_transition.prediction_correction: E48's weather-expiry hypothesis was falsified by retained replay. The source row has permanent Rain and a Golduck with Cloud Nine switching in; it does not contain a final-weather-turn expiry.
forecast_cloud_nine_transition.showdown_transcript: Golduck enters under Rain, Castform remains Water through Return, and Rain continues at upkeep.
forecast_cloud_nine_transition.root_cause: The engine ran Forecast after every switch and every special-effect dispatch, treating Cloud Nine suppression as a weather transition.

color_change_freeze_ordering.showdown_transcript: Seaking Ice Beam damages Kecleon, freezes it, then Color Change makes it Ice; Kecleon emits cant|frz and does not use Brick Break.
color_change_freeze_ordering.root_cause: Color Change ran before Ice Beam's freeze secondary, so Kecleon became Ice-type and falsely rejected freeze.

Defer Color Change until after damaging-move secondaries and stop a slower action freshly frozen by that first action.
Run Forecast before a departing weather suppressor is replaced, including suppressor-to-suppressor handoffs, while retaining suppression from the opposite active Pokemon.
